name: Shenzhen Hipine Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Hipine Precision Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells watches and related accessories in China. The company offers gold-case and gold-bezel watches, smart wearable jewelry, precious metal smart watches, and fashion accessories under the HIPINE and Goldbear brand names. It also provides original design manufacturing services, including development and production of private-label precious metal watches and accessories, as well as subcontract processing services.
